card.name: Fetal in pregnancy-risk wording
card.fires_on: The word fetal, or its ending (fet-al, atal), in embryo-fetal toxicity headings and in phrases like "may cause fetal harm" in pregnancy warnings.

modes.label: Embryo-fetal headings
modes.description: The ending of fetal inside embryo-fetal toxicity titles and boxed warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, EMBRYO-FET<<AL>> TOXICITY, and PUL

modes.label: Fetal harm phrase
modes.description: The word fetal right after "may cause" before harm.
modes.example: lefamulin may cause<< fetal>> harm when administered to pregnant women.

card.plain: It lights up on the word fetal in pregnancy-risk warnings, such as embryo-fetal toxicity or fetal harm.
evidence: Exposure to ZIIHERA during pregnancy can cause embryo-f<<etal>> harm.
riociguat may cause<< fetal>> harm if used during pregnancy.
